posts.title: Connecting the Dots: A Travel Experiment
posts.description: In October 2023, I decided to run a travel experiment . I had several months of free time, and I realized I was terrible at keeping in touch with people, especially after moving across multiple countries. posts.title: A History of IDEs at Google
posts.description: I previously discussed how the main codebase at Google enforces strict tooling and conventions to allow the codebase to scale. posts.title: The best demos of 2025 from the demoscene
posts.description: Many software engineers I know are familiar with the demoscene, but very few follow it actively. Every year, around 2,000 productions are released. Once in a while, a masterpiece like .kkrieger or Elevated becomes famous, but most of the best work stays inside the scene. To filter the noise, juries of demosceners nominate the best productions of the year for the Meteoriks awards. The 2026 nominees
